observations: A large black plastic water tank with horizontal ribbing, standing outdoors on a dirt ground.
The tank has a top lid with a circular opening and a side outlet with a green cap.
Visible dirt, scratches, and water stains on the surface, especially on the lower half.
The tank appears to be used, with some wear and possible leakage (dark liquid on the ground).
Other similar tanks are visible in the background, including one blue and one black ribbed tank.
No visible brand or model name on the tank itself in any photo.
The seller claims it is 1500 litres, fairly used, and in good condition for home, public, or site work.

claims.evidence: No capacity marking visible on the tank in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: fairly used and in good condition
claims.evidence: The tank shows visible dirt, scratches, and water stains, suggesting use. However, no internal condition or structural integrity is shown. The presence of dark liquid on the ground suggests possible leakage, which contradicts 'good condition'.

claims.claim: can be used for home, public or site work
claims.evidence: This is a functional claim that cannot be verified from photos alone. The tank's material and condition do not confirm suitability for all uses.

risks.proof: A close-up shot of the side outlet and the interior of the tank, showing no cracks or leaks, and a video of the tank being filled and drained.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially leaking or structurally compromised

risks.proof: A photo showing a measuring tape or a label with the capacity marked on the tank.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown capacity, which may be lower than claimed

risks.proof: A video or photo of the interior of the tank, showing cleanliness and no residue or debris.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially contaminated, which reduces usability for drinking or water storage

proof_requests: Close-up of the metal plate showing the brand and model, usually on the bottom or side.
A photo or video showing the interior of the tank to check for residue or damage.
A photo with a measuring tape showing the height or diameter to estimate capacity.
A video of the tank being filled and drained to confirm no leaks.
A clear photo of any capacity label or marking on the tank.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
